mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to implement GEO for FAQ Pages?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to implement GEO for FAQ Pages varies significantly based on several factors. These include the number of FAQ pages you have, the complexity of your localization requirements, whether you're performing the work in-house or hiring an external agency, and the level of research required for local keyword integration. For businesses managing their own content, the primary cost is time and labor. If you engage a digital marketing agency specializing in AI visibility solutions, costs would involve service fees for content optimization, keyword research, and implementation, typically priced per project or on a retainer basis.
